title: Kahoot Lobby Music
blurb: An entire generation's nervous system was rewired by this loop. The Kahoot lobby music plays while everybody types in a rude nickname and the teacher pretends not to notice, and it has been doing so in classrooms worldwide for over a decade. The Norwegian company behind it turned a pub quiz into a school-wide adrenaline event — the waiting theme is the part people actually remember. Relentlessly bouncy. Play it before any group activity and watch grown adults sit up straight without knowing why.
origin: The lobby waiting music from the Kahoot! quiz platform.
